name: VoidAuth
description: VoidAuth is an open-source authentication platform that streamlines user management and access control for self-hosted applications. Centered on OpenID Connect (OIDC) integration, it also offers first class support for Proxy ForwardAuth (ProxyAuth). With a focus on an intuitive end-user and administrator web interface, VoidAuth provides a seamless and professional authentication experience.

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: URL VoidAuth will be served on. Must start with https://

variables.name: Default Redirect
variables.description: The home/landing/app url for your domain. This is where users will be redirected upon accepting an invitation, logout, or clicking the logo when already on the auth home page. Will default to App URL if not provided.

variables.name: Allow Registration
variables.description: Allow new users to self-register themselves without invitation.

variables.name: Registration Requires Approval
variables.description: Whether new users who register themselves require approval by an admin. Setting this to false while SIGNUP is true enables open self-registration; use with caution!

variables.name: Enable Email Verification
variables.description: If true, users must have an email address and will get a verification email when changing their email address before it can be used. If you are using an email provider, this should be set to true.

variables.name: App Title
variables.description: Title that will show on the web interface, use your own brand/app/title.

variables.name: App Color
variables.description: Theme color in hex format

variables.name: Contact Email
variables.description: The email address used for 'Contact Us' links, which are shown on most end-user pages if this is set.

variables.name: Database - Host
variables.description: Host address of the Postgres database.

variables.name: Database - Port
variables.description: Port number of the Postgres database.

variables.name: Database - Name
variables.description: Name of the Postgres database.

variables.name: Database - User
variables.description: Username for the Postgres database.

variables.name: Database - Password
variables.description: Password for the Postgres database.

variables.name: Storage Key - Primary
variables.description: Storage encryption key for secret values such as keys and client secrets. Must be at least 32 characters long and should be randomly generated.

variables.name: Storage Key - Secondary
variables.description: Secondary storage encryption key, used when rotating the primary storage encryption key.

variables.name: SMTP - Host
variables.description: Hostname of the SMTP server to use for sending emails.

variables.name: SMTP - Port
variables.description: Port number of the SMTP server.

variables.name: SMTP - Username
variables.description: Username for authenticating with the SMTP server.

variables.name: SMTP - Password
variables.description: Password for authenticating with the SMTP server.

variables.name: SMTP - From Address
variables.description: Email address that emails will be sent from.

variables.name: SMTP - Secure
variables.description: Whether to use a secure connection (TLS) when connecting to the SMTP server.

variables.name: Password Strength
variables.description: The minimum strength of users passwords, at least 3 is recommended.

variables.name: Admin Emails
variables.description: The minimum duration between admin notification emails. Can be set to values like: '4 hours', '30 minutes', 'weekly', 'daily', etc. If set to 'false', admin notification emails are disabled.

variables.name: Internal App Port
variables.description: Internal web interface port. Not recommended to change.
